title: घड़े वाला राजा: 300 घड़ों ने कैसे हराई 10,000 की सेना
topic: Hindi YouTube Short telling the medieval siege story of The Pot King who bought 300 clay pots, kept them warm overnight, and unleashed 3 million angry bees on 10,000 climbing soldiers at dawn.

global_style.art_style: High-detail realistic anime illustration style inspired by Vinland Saga and Ufotable dark medieval fantasy, gritty stone castle architecture, weathered steel armor, flickering torchlight, atmospheric frost and golden dawn light, sharp expressive faces, 9:16 vertical portrait framing.
global_style.negative_prompt: cartoonish chibi, bright flat colors, modern clothing, blurry, distorted faces, extra fingers, garbled text, horizontal framing, watermarks

beats.narration: राजा ने पूरे राज्य के सारे मिट्टी के घड़े खरीद लिए— पूरे तीन सौ घड़े— क्योंकि दस हज़ार सैनिकों की सेना दीवारों से बस दो दिन दूर थी।

clips.scene_context: Weathered medieval king paying gold coins at a market stall stacked with terracotta clay pots.
clips.image_prompt: Realistic anime style, 9:16 vertical framing, stern older medieval king with iron-grey beard and dark fur-lined crimson cloak handing gold coins to a potter beside towering stacks of brown clay pots.

clips.spoken_text: पूरे तीन सौ घड़े—

clips.spoken_text: क्योंकि दस हज़ार सैनिकों की सेना दीवारों से बस दो दिन दूर थी।

clips.image_prompt: Realistic anime style, 9:16 vertical wide cinematic shot, colossal sea of 10,000 dark-armored soldiers and banners marching through dusty dusk valleys toward towering stone castle walls on the horizon.
